entries.text: Hello, class! It is I, Hassel, yet again.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_01

entries.text: My, my, how time flies, as they say![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_02

entries.text: Indeed, our time together has certainly flown by.\nIt’s hard to believe that this is our last class.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_03

entries.text: Now, our topics for today may feel somewhat\nunrelated to art.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_04

entries.text: But there is absolutely no set definition as to\nwhat art should be![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_05

entries.text: Therefore, let us carry on with the discussion and\nsee where it takes us![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_06

entries.text: There are two things I wish to focus on today—\nRibbons...and marks![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_07

entries.text: Both Ribbons and marks are special honors that\ncapture a Pokémon’s qualities.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_08

entries.text: There will be times when your Pokémon gives\nmaximum effort or has a noteworthy experience.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_09

entries.text: In recognition of its feats and accomplishments,\nit can be given a Ribbon.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_10

entries.text: To give an example, if you manage to become\nincredibly close to a Pokémon, it may be granted\r\nthe Best Friends Ribbon.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_11

entries.text: Incidentally, there is a person in Cascarrafa who\ncan give your Pokémon a Best Friends Ribbon.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_12

entries.text: Marks, on the other hand, are mostly found on\nwild Pokémon when you meet them for the\r\nfirst time.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_13

entries.text: They can symbolize the character of a Pokémon,\nsuch as with the Rowdy Mark or the Vigor Mark.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_14

entries.text: It’s completely up to luck whether you’ll run into\na Pokémon with these marks![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_15

entries.text: So if you’re able to catch a Pokémon with a\nmark, rejoice at your outstanding fortune![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_16

entries.text: Does anyone know what special thing you can do\nwith Pokémon that have Ribbons or marks?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_17

entries.text: You can exchange Ribbons!
entries.label: class_f_07_select_01

entries.text: You can show them off!
entries.label: class_f_07_select_02

entries.text: You can change their title!
entries.label: class_f_07_select_03

entries.text: Ah, unfortunately, you can’t transfer Ribbons or\nmarks from one Pokémon to another, nor can you\r\ntrade them with other people’s Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_answer_01

entries.text: Well, yes, indeed you can show them off, but\nsurely that’s not the extent of your interest, is it?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_answer_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wonderful, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Your
knowledge
is
impressive.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_answer_03

entries.text: The correct answer is that Pokémon with Ribbons\nor marks can be given titles.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_18

entries.text: What’s more, they can be sent into battle\ndisplaying a title of your choosing![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_19

entries.text: For example, you could send out a Gible with\na Best Friends Ribbon by declaring...\r\n“Go! Gible the Great Friend!”[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_20

entries.text: And while I know I just said that marks are\ngenerally found already on Pokémon when you\r\nmeet them for the first time...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_21

entries.text: it seems that more recently, Pokémon can be\nawarded certain marks based on their efforts.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_22

entries.text: These are marks such as the Gourmand Mark,\nthe Itemfinder Mark, the Partner Mark, and so on.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_23

entries.text: Perhaps it might be fun to try to work out how to\nget each mark using its name as a clue?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_24

entries.text: Well, that just about wraps up our last class![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_25

entries.text: Next is the final exam. Please review our material\nclosely so that you pass on your first try![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_07_dragon_26
